label: Cancer resistance
query: (cancer resistance OR tumor resistance) AND (animal OR species OR comparative OR evolution)

label: Regeneration
query: (regeneration OR scarless healing OR tissue regeneration) AND (animal OR species OR comparative)

label: Hypoxia / ischemia tolerance
query: (hypoxia tolerance OR ischemia tolerance OR anoxia tolerance) AND (animal OR species OR comparative)

label: Longevity / DNA maintenance
query: (longevity OR exceptional lifespan) AND (DNA repair OR genome maintenance OR cancer) AND (species OR comparative)

label: Infection tolerance
query: (viral tolerance OR pathogen tolerance OR disease resistance) AND (animal OR species OR comparative)

label: Organ preservation / extreme stress
query: (freeze tolerance OR desiccation tolerance OR organ preservation OR hibernation) AND (animal OR species)

label: Pain / neurobiology
query: (venom OR toxin OR analgesia OR pain) AND (animal OR species) AND (ion channel OR receptor OR neuro)

label: Thrombosis / immobility tolerance
query: (thrombosis resistance OR coagulation OR immobility) AND (animal OR hibernation OR comparative)
